carries: GENERATION AUDIT. Rule 5 demanded a duration AND a doneness cue on every cooking step, which threw out 'bake for 18 to 20 minutes'; it asks for one or the other. 'heat', 'melt' and 'reduce' no longer count as cooking, so 'remove from the heat' stops killing recipes. The step-length ceiling is one number in the prompt, the validator and the standard
every rejected draft is kept in data/generated/rejected.json with its reasons — a rejection that is only printed cannot be audited
the pool fill aims at the youngest ages and the five major allergens: fourteen of twenty recipes now target six or nine months, against four before

the swipe field is a glass pill that fills with the finger: brand to mark, ink to undo, full at the threshold, a tick when it fills; the app has no flat colour block anywhere else and this one is gone
